note: Foothills Lions Club campground on Town of Diamond Valley land at the west end of Black Diamond, 303 5 St SW, between the Sheep River and the town; walking distance to downtown, river pathways, disc golf and mountain-bike trails. On-site camp host; the club says sites fill quickly in peak season. --Claude
summary: Lions Club page + town page: C$45 + GST daily (weekly C$285, monthly C$1,000), phone/request-form booking, open May-October, wifi/dump/showers confirmed; riverfront looks overstated (riverview recommended). The pages do not state amperage or per-site water/sewer (derived hookups left alone).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverfront, checked hard): recommend DOWNGRADE to riverview. Esri imagery (0.49 m/px) shows the west row of RV sites ~15-20 m from the Sheep River channel, but the campground's own perimeter road and a riprap bank run between every site and the water; the rest of the loop is 60-150 m back. Own loop road between = riverview at best. The Lions page calls it 'a peaceful riverside setting ... along the Sheep River' (marketing prose, not the gate).
LONG-STAY: weekly and monthly rates posted and the page says 'Best for: Short or long stays'; nightly C$45 is posted and nights are sold, Lions-run on town land (ownership local stands). No concern.

HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 / water / sewer (derived from note prose) are not stated on the club or town pages (town feature list says only 'Electricity', 'Water'); left alone, unverified. The club's sister campground page says paying campers there use the sewer facilities at Bob Lochhead.
PHONE: 403-933-5785 confirmed on the club page ('Seasonal: March - October'). The town page also lists 403-933-4348 (town office). Booking email campground@foothillslionsclub.ca.

WEBSITE: recommend https://www.foothillslionsclub.ca/campground/blackdiamond (200, the operator's page with rates) in place of or ahead of the town facility page (200, which says 'The Town of Diamond Valley does not manage the Bob Lochead Memorial Campground').
